title: Great product, sizes could be better
text: Great product, sizes could be better. Great product, sizes could be better.  I love using stretchable silicone to seal bowls of food, etc. My problem with this set is only that too many of them are much smaller than I need for my purposes. I use the biggest one many times more often than the medium sized ones, and I use the smallest not at all, Perhaps because I do not store food in open cans in the fridge. Try to find yourself a set featuring large sizes.
